pattern: Static content: a heading (or paragraph) with description and native buttons or links; optionally a polite status region so its appearance is announced.

aria.value: true (the icon or illustration is decorative)

keyboard.action: The primary action, then the secondary action.

focus: The empty state never takes or moves focus; when it replaces content that had focus, the application decides where focus goes.
notes: Use headingLevel to fit the page outline; inside tables and lists use null so the title is plain text.
live announces the title and description when the empty state appears, for example after a search.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
